title: PATCH /routes/{id} – request
description: Change the given properties of a route; the site cannot change, the checkpoints change with a new version. Deleting a route deletes its schedules. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/route.response.json.

order_mode.description: fixed: checkpoints must be scanned by position; free: any order.
